items.title: Hilb^d of a smooth relative curve is smooth of relative dimension d
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter pic.tex (Picard Schemes of Curves)
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file pic.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Prove the Hilb schemes are smooth of relative dimension d over S: base cases Hilb^0 = S and Hilb^1 = X; induction step: Hilb^d x_S X is smooth over S (base change and composition of smooth morphisms) and maps finite locally free of degree d+1 onto Hilb^{d+1} (lemma-universal-object), so smoothness descends (descent-lemma-smooth-permanence); the relative dimension check (fibres or dimension bookkeeping) is left to the reader.
